pageTitle: Sport Challenge · Sports challenges among friends
metaDescription: Create a sports challenge of a few weeks, invite your friends and log your sessions: every sport counts, and each category has its podium. Free.

hero.title: Challenge your friends, week after week.
hero.lede: Create a challenge of a few weeks, invite your crew with a link and log your sessions: running, cycling, yoga, climbing… Every activity counts, and each category has its podium.
hero.noPassword: No password: we email you a code.

preview.title: Fall challenge
preview.podiumNote: The time of every activity, every sport included.

create.title: Create a challenge
create.text: Pick the length, from 2 to 52 weeks, the first day and the categories. Public or private by invitation: you also decide whether participants can invite.

invite.title: Invite your friends
invite.text: Send the challenge link. People can join until the end of its first week.

move.title: Move and compare
move.text: A logged session counts in all your challenges, for the week it started. Each week is settled the day after it ends, at 7 a.m. challenge time. Until then, you can still edit your sessions.

categories.title: A podium per category
categories.lede: Total time is always there. Add the other categories to suit your crew: each has its podium, so a challenge has several winners.

time.text: Every activity counts, every sport included: running, yoga, climbing, rowing…

distance.text: The km of each sport are converted to the reference sport: 10 km of cycling count as 3 km of running.

elimination.text: From week 2, cover at least your distance of the week before, plus a few km, every week. Otherwise, you're out of this category. And this one only.
elimination.win: Among those still in, most km wins.

points.text: Each week, the top 5 or 10 of each criterion score points: longest session, most sessions… depending on the challenge's criteria.

elevation.text: The elevation gain of all your outings that have one (running, cycling, hiking…), in meters.

categories.reference: The reference sport is running by default. The creator can pick cycling, swimming, rowing… Settings are locked at creation: creators don't change the rules midway.
categories.fairness: Everyone is ranked in every category of the challenge, with no handicap or level category. In case of a tie: tied ranks.

sports.title: From yoga to rowing, it all counts
sports.lede: Every minute counts toward total time. For distance, sports faster than the reference sport are converted to it with a factor.
sports.note: Factors relative to running, suggested and adjustable when creating the challenge. Your sport isn't listed? Choose “Other” and name it.
sports.manualTitle: You log your sessions by hand, once.
sports.manualText: Each one counts in every challenge you take part in.

visibility.a: In a challenge, the other participants see the details of your sessions. Your email is visible only to you and the app's administrator.

password.a: You sign in with a one-time code sent by email: nothing to remember, nothing to steal.

join.q: Can I join a challenge that has already started?
join.a: Yes, until the end of its first week.

leave.a: Yes, but it means giving up all its categories, for good.

phone.a: The site installs on your phone's home screen, like an app.

data.a: In Canada: the app is hosted on Google Cloud in Montréal, and sign-in goes through Auth0, Canada region.

final.title: Ready to start your first challenge?
final.text: Sign in with your email, create a challenge and send the link to your crew.
